Fusion Miniguns are a special kind of fusion weapon. Unlike Blasters, they fire slowly and have limited ammo, but inflict the most damage of any machinegun in the game. They also have further reduced range dropoff, increasing their maximum range.

Alien fusion bolts are more compact than an equivalent fusion bolt, and have a shorter optimal range. However, they are not as heavily affected by range dropoff penalties, and therefore still have a higher maximum range. This fusion minigun has a dropoff rate of 4% per tile.

Fusion Miniguns recovered on the battlefield are DNA-locked and cannot be used by human units. Xenonaut engineers can eventually defeat the DNA lock and create human-usable Fusion Miniguns, but they cannot be upgraded further.
